subject: Invoice origination authorization and webhook fallback for Acme
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice origination authorization and webhook fallback for Acme

Hi Kim / Connor —

Acme is moving to a new AP intake process and asked whether Redwood will be the invoice originator (i.e., we generate the invoice XML/PDF and push it into their ingestion endpoint) or whether they should continue to create invoices themselves and accept our charges via portal/email. They flagged two immediate constraints:

- Their AP system can accept a supplier-push webhook (JSON/XML) but won’t go live for another 3–4 weeks.
- In the interim they need a reliable PDF copy to ap@acmecorp.com (they prefer supplier-originated PDFs with our invoice-numbering).

Questions:
1) Can Finance own origination for this account (single-entity, US)? If yes, what’s the minimal data set they need from Sales/Eng to populate the XML (PO number, remit entity, VAT tag — although not applicable here)?
2) If Finance originates, can we do a portal push + email copy fallback (email copy to AP) until webhook is available?
3) Any gating legal/collection flags we should surface before we start issuing invoices on their behalf?

I attached the Acme AP requirements document they shared (Acme_AP_requirements.pdf). I also attached a Redwood sample invoice (redwood_sample_invoice.xml) so we can confirm field mapping.

Goal: confirm ownership and rollout plan today so we can schedule the first push before EoW.

Thanks —
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Manager, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice origination authorization and webhook fallback for Acme

Thanks Aditya —

Short answers up front: finance can originate invoices for Acme (US entity) and push to their intake, with an email-copy fallback while webhook is being stood up. We need the following minimum fields from Sales/Eng to produce the XML and PDF correctly:
- Purchase Order (PO) number (required for their AP matching)
- Bill-to legal name and remit address (we need exact entity)
- Billing contact email (for their internal reconciliation)
- Billing currency and tax treatment (US: no VAT)

Operational notes:
- We'll include Redwood's invoice_number prefix (RWI-) and put Acme PO in the reference field.
- For the interim email copy, AP asked that the PDF subject line include invoice_number and PO to ease OCR.
- We should not set up automatic debit/collection until first invoice is acknowledged by AP (one-off to confirm matching).

Can you confirm PO + remit entity today? If Connor can pass the technical mapping to Eng (sample xml attached), I'll scope one push and an email-copy flow.

Kimberly Park
Senior Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Tan <claire.tan@acmecorp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@acmecorp.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice origination authorization and webhook fallback for Acme

Hi Aditya / Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Confirmations from our side:
- Acme prefers suppliers to push invoices to our ingestion endpoint (https://ingest.acmecorp.com/invoices). We can accept XML or JSON with the following required fields: invoice_number, invoice_date, total_amount, currency, PO_number, remit_entity_id, line_items[].
- Webhook/ingest will be production-ready on 12 Mar 2028.
- For now please send PDFs to ap@acmecorp.com with the file name pattern: INVOICE_<invoice_number>_PO_<PO_number>.pdf. Our AP team will manually ingest emailed PDFs until webhook is live.

AP contact: Sarah Liao (ap@acmecorp.com) — she will confirm receipt the first time and flag any matching issues.

One ask: we require the remit_entity_id (internal code) in the XML payload; I included that field in the attached AP requirements doc. If you can include that field in your sample XML mapping, that will speed onboarding.

Claire Tan
Head of Procurement, Acme Corporation
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Claire Tan <claire.tan@acmecorp.com>, AP Team <ap@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice origination authorization and webhook fallback for Acme

Claire —
Appreciate the details and the ingest URL. We'll proceed with the following plan:

1) Finance (Kim/Marissa) will originate invoices for Acme starting with the next billing cycle.
2) Delivery: push XML to https://ingest.acmecorp.com/invoices on the live date (12 Mar). For the first two weeks (15 Feb — 11 Mar) we'll send supplier-originated PDFs to ap@acmecorp.com using the filename convention Claire provided.
3) Technical mapping: Connor/Eng, please ensure remit_entity_id is present in the outgoing payload (sample attached: redwood_sample_invoice.xml).
4) Ops: Marissa, can you take on the first three emailed PDFs and confirm receipt with Sarah (ap@acmecorp.com)? If AP flags any PO matching issues, do not escalate collection — route back to Sales.

I will confirm PO and remit entity today (Aditya to follow up).

Thanks —
Aditya
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice origination authorization and webhook fallback for Acme

Thanks team — quick operational note recorded in the billing runbook:

- Ownership: Finance (Marissa) will originate and push supplier XML/PDF.
- Interim window (15 Feb — 11 Mar): email PDFs to ap@acmecorp.com with filename INVOICE_<invoice_number>_PO_<PO_number>.pdf.
- Field mapping: include remit_entity_id, PO_number, invoice_number (RWI- prefix), currency. Connor, please include mapping comments in the shared Drive doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cAcmeAPReqs
- Legal: no special collection permissions; do not enable auto-debit.

I'll run the first three email PDFs and post confirmations to the runbook. If Claire/Sarah confirm receipt, we'll cut over to webhook on 12 Mar.

Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
